content.title: Senior AI Automation Specialist — LLMs + Make.com / n8n (Long-term, IC or PM Route)
content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
We are a small, fully remote, async-first team building production AI automation systems for companies around the world using LLMs, Make.com, and n8n.

We deliberately avoid a fast-paced, high-pressure agency culture. Instead, we optimize for deep work, clear priorities, sustainability, and high standards without unnecessary urgency.

We are hiring a Senior AI Automation Specialist for a long-term engagement. This is intentionally a senior-only role. You should have 3+ years of hands-on AI automation experience, have shipped multiple real production systems using LLMs with Make.com or n8n, and have worked directly with clients across multiple projects.

You should be comfortable handling scoping, client communication, and changes independently. You should also be able to design systems end-to-end rather than simply connecting tools, while thinking about real-world trade-offs such as ROI, cost, reliability, and maintenance.

Everyone starts hands-on. Over time, the role can grow in one of two directions: a deep individual contributor path with full technical ownership, or a leadership path involving project management, product thinking, client communication, and mentoring.

Compensation is $20–$35/hr for a senior hands-on IC focus and $30–$50/hr for senior ICs who also take on project management, product ownership, and client leadership. Final rates depend on experience and level of responsibility. Long-term leadership and equity opportunities may also be available for exceptional contributors.

The hiring process is simple and respectful of your time: answer the application questions, complete a small 45–60 minute practical task with a short Loom explaining your thinking, and then join one relaxed call.

If you are junior, mid-level, or still learning, please do not apply.
</untrusted_participant_content>

content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
### Title: AI Automation & Workflow Expert for Sales, Marketing, and Business Operations

I'm looking for an experienced AI automation specialist to help me design and build practical, connected workflows for my business.

I'm very AI-savvy and already use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude (CoWork, Code), Codex, Granola, Wispr Flow, and Airtable. However, I haven't yet brought these tools together into standardized, end-to-end workflows within my own business. I'm looking for someone who can help me move from using individual AI tools to building reliable automations that work together.

I view my business across three pillars:

- Growth
- Build
- Operate

The initial focus will likely be Growth—particularly sales, marketing, events, content etc

My CRM and sales data currently live in Airtable. I have well-defined buyer personas and offer architecture. I've developed many of my sales and marketing processes manually, and I'm now ready to make them more consistent, scalable, and efficient.

Potential opportunities include:

- Streamlining the process from planning an event through outreach and follow-up
- Capturing insights and action items from meeting notes and conversations
- Identifying engagement, buying, and follow-up signals
- Creating personalized outreach and conversion follow-ups
- Turning my ideas, conversations, and work into marketing content
- Drafting and managing LinkedIn content workflows
- Connecting CRM data with content, outreach, and follow-up activities
- Standardizing the different AI tools I currently use
- Designing human-in-the-loop workflows so I can review important content and communications before they are published or sent

I'm not looking for someone to simply recommend a collection of tools. I want a partner who can first understand how I currently work, identify the highest-value opportunities, design the right workflow architecture, and then help build and document the automations.

The ideal person will have experience with:

- AI-powered workflow design and automation
- Airtable-based CRM workflows (open to other)
- Sales and marketing automation
- Event-driven outreach and follow-up
- LLM tools such as ChatGPT and Claude
- Content creation and LinkedIn workflows
- Integrating multiple tools through platforms such as Make, Zapier, n8n, APIs, or similar technologies
- Building reliable workflows with appropriate human review and approval steps

Initial deliverables may include:

1. Review and map my existing tools and manual processes
2. Recommend a standardized workflow and technology approach
3. Prioritize a small number of high-impact automations
4. Build and test the first end-to-end workflow
5. Document the system so it can be maintained and expanded
6. Recommend a roadmap for automations across Growth, Build, and Operate

When applying, please share:

- Examples of similar AI-enabled business workflows you have built
- Your experience connecting various business tools
- How you approach workflow discovery and prioritization
- The platforms you typically use and why
- Whether you can support both workflow architecture and hands-on implementation

I'd like to begin with one clearly scoped workflow and expand the engagement if we work well together.
</untrusted_participant_content>

content.title: AI Automation Engineer — n8n/Make, Slack, Notion, Dialpad and Follow Up Boss
content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
I'm looking for an experienced AI automation engineer to help build a practical internal operations system for a real estate team.

The system will connect Slack, Notion, Dialpad, Gmail, Google Calendar, Claude and Follow Up Boss using n8n or Make. n8n is preferred, but I'm open to Make if you can explain why it is the better choice.

This is not a chatbot or basic Zapier project. I need someone who understands APIs, webhooks, structured data, approval workflows, duplicate prevention and reliable error handling.

Initial priorities:

* Capture requests from my team leader across email, text, calls and notes
* Identify assignments, deadlines, missing information and next actions
* Create one organized task system in Notion
* Track real estate transactions, deadlines and blockers
* Post summaries, alerts and draft replies in Slack
* Allow me to review, revise and approve actions through Slack
* Summarize Dialpad calls and associate them with the correct contact
* Prevent duplicate tasks, messages and CRM records
* Keep unconfirmed transaction information separate from verified facts
* Create morning and evening priority briefings

Later phases may include:

* Context-aware Gmail and Dialpad reply drafting
* Follow Up Boss updates
* PLAUD and Google Drive note intake
* More advanced transaction-stage tracking
* Claude-assisted document and deliverable creation
* Controlled browser automation when an API cannot perform an action

Required experience:

* n8n or Make
* REST APIs and webhooks
* Slack apps or interactive Slack messages
* Notion databases and API
* Gmail and Google Calendar integrations
* Claude, OpenAI or another LLM API
* CRM integrations
* JSON and basic JavaScript
* Error logging, retries and duplicate prevention
* Secure management of API keys and credentials

Experience with Follow Up Boss, Dialpad or real estate workflows is strongly preferred but not required if you have strong general API experience.

The project will begin with a paid 10-hour test.

Test workflow:

1. Receive a sample completed-call event.
2. retrieve or accept the call transcript.
3. Generate a structured summary and action items.
4. Match the caller with a Notion contact.
5. Post the summary in Slack for review.
6. Save the communication in Notion.
7. Prevent the same event from creating duplicate records.
8. Log any workflow failure.
9. Provide basic documentation.

The initial test is capped at 10 hours and $250. If the test is successful, I plan to continue building the system in controlled phases.

Important requirements:

* All workflows must live in accounts I control.
* I must own all code, connections and documentation.
* Important messages cannot send without my approval.
* Transaction facts and stage changes require confirmation.
* Each phase must have an agreed hour limit.
* You must provide a working demonstration before a phase is accepted.
* You must communicate clearly and explain the system in plain English.

When applying, please answer:

1. Which would you use for this project—n8n or Make—and why?
2. Describe a similar multi-platform automation you personally built.
3. How would you prevent duplicate records if a webhook fires twice?
4. How would you create a Slack approval workflow for an AI-generated reply?
5. How would you separate an uncertain transaction update from a confirmed fact?
6. What would you do if Follow Up Boss or Dialpad cannot perform an action through its API?
7. Can you complete the 10-hour paid test before requesting a larger contract?
8. Please include screenshots, a short video or another example of a workflow you personally built.

Please do not send a generic AI-generated proposal. Begin your response with the words "Slack approval" so I know you read the full description.
</untrusted_participant_content>

content.title: Lead AI Engineer / Full-Stack AI Developer — Build 24/7 Real Estate Lead Generation Platform
content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
Senior AI Engineer / Full-Stack Developer — Build 24/7 Real Estate AI Lead Generation System

We are a Florida-based real estate company looking for an experienced AI Engineer / Full-Stack Developer to design and build a powerful AI-driven lead generation and sales platform.

This is NOT a simple chatbot or basic automation project.

Our goal is to build an AI system that operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to attract, engage, qualify, nurture, and convert real estate buyers from across the United States and international markets who are interested in purchasing or investing in Florida real estate.

What We Want to Build

The system should eventually handle the complete process:

Lead Acquisition → AI Conversation → Qualification → CRM → Lead Scoring → Property Matching → Automated Follow-Up → Appointment → Human Agent

We want the AI platform to:

* Communicate with prospects 24/7
* Support English and Spanish initially, with additional languages later
* Communicate through website chat, WhatsApp, SMS, and email
* Ask intelligent qualification questions
* Determine investment budget
* Identify cash vs. financing
* Determine purchase timeline
* Understand investment goals and preferred Florida markets
* Automatically score and prioritize buyers
* Store conversations and customer information in our CRM
* Alert our agents when a high-quality buyer is identified
* Automatically schedule appointments
* Follow up with leads over weeks or months
* Re-engage older leads
* Connect with approved real estate/property data
* Match buyers with relevant properties
* Eventually provide property and investment analysis
* Track lead sources, engagement, appointments, contracts, and closings

Example

An investor in Colombia sees one of our advertisements for Florida investment properties.

They contact us at 2:00 AM Florida time.

The AI immediately communicates with them in Spanish and determines:

* Budget: $1,000,000
* Cash buyer
* Interested in Miami and Fort Lauderdale
* Investment property
* Purchase timeline: 60 days
* Interested in rental income

The AI records the information in our CRM, scores the lead, continues nurturing the buyer, recommends appropriate properties, and schedules an appointment with one of our agents.

Our goal is for our sales team to wake up and find qualified buyers and appointments waiting for them, rather than simply receiving unqualified internet leads.

Required Experience

We are looking for someone with strong experience in:

* OpenAI API / LLM development
* AI agents and tool/function calling
* Python
* Node.js / TypeScript
* API development and integrations
* PostgreSQL or similar databases
* AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
* CRM integrations
* WhatsApp Business API
* Twilio / SMS
* Email automation
* Webhooks
* AI workflow automation
* Authentication and security
* Production AI applications

Experience with real estate technology, MLS/RESO/IDX data, Follow Up Boss, HubSpot, Meta/Google lead integrations, AI voice agents, or multilingual AI systems is a major plus.

Important

We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to ChatGPT prompts, basic Zapier workflows, or simple no-code chatbots.

We need an experienced developer who can help architect, code, deploy, secure, and maintain a real production system.

We want someone who can understand our business objectives and recommend the best technical architecture rather than waiting for us to tell them exactly what code to write.

Long-Term Opportunity

This will begin as a development project, but we are looking for someone who could potentially work with us long-term and become the lead developer behind our AI infrastructure.

We plan to continue investing in the platform as it proves successful.

All custom source code, databases, prompts, workflows, integrations, documentation, and intellectual property developed specifically for this project must be owned by our company. Company production accounts and credentials will remain under company control.

TO APPLY

Please start your proposal with the words:

FLORIDA AI

Then answer the following:

1. What is the most advanced AI system you have personally built?
2. Have you built AI agents that interact with APIs, databases, CRMs, or external tools?
3. What parts of those systems did you personally develop?
4. Have you integrated WhatsApp, SMS, email, or a CRM with AI?
5. What technology stack would you recommend for this project?
6. How would you architect our first version?
7. Please provide examples, GitHub links, demos, or videos of previous AI projects.
8. What country and time zone are you located in?
9. How many hours per week are you available?
10. What is your hourly rate?

We are looking for a serious AI engineer who wants to help us build an ambitious long-term platform, not someone looking to sell us a basic chatbot.
</untrusted_participant_content>
